input.text: Your loop counter needs to include index 0. Right now it begins at 1, so it adds the second, third, and later elements but never the first one. In Python, a range is inclusive of its start and exclusive of its stop, so starting at 1 literally means "skip index 0." Change the loop so it begins at the first index, or iterate directly over the list of numbers themselves, so every value gets added.

content.text: The loop begins one position too late, excluding index 0. Starting at the first index (or iterating over the values directly) will include every number.
